info.title: Beauty on Wheels - Vehicle Service API
info.description: Customer garage vehicles and the canonical vehicle-type list.

get.description: Requires a bearer access token. Returns only vehicles owned by the authenticated user. Query status (ACTIVE or INACTIVE) or vehicleType. The platform envelope puts the list at data.items.
